title: filter: contrast() - Filters - Tailwind CSS
content_text: FILTERS filter: contrast() Utilities for applying contrast filters to an element. Class Styles contrast- filter: contrast(%); contrast-() filter: contrast(var()); contrast-[] filter: contrast(); EXAMPLES Basic example Use utilities like contrast-50 and contrast-100 to control an element's contrast: contrast-50 contrast-100 contrast-125 contrast-200 Using a custom value Use the contrast-[] syntax to set the contrast based on a completely custom value: For CSS variables, you can also use the contrast-() syntax: This is just a shorthand for contrast-[var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Responsive design Prefix a filter: contrast() utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above: Learn more about using variants in the variants documentation. brightness drop-shadow
